scope: Label-use, operation and freeze descriptions of each data role. Allocations, fold counts and seeds are read from cross_morse/split_contract.py, data/sources.json and the full configurations.

fit.operation: fit plant/head; audit entry contract and bands
fit.frozen_after: model, preprocessing, nominal action, band definitions

explore.operation: fit observer, action and sequence models

select.operation: reconstruct q_C; compare every (π, E, b)

confirm.frozen_after: teacher q_M, mechanism label and downgrade

compare.operation: E3–E6 against frozen q_M and q_C
compare.frozen_after: independent comparison record; no automatic deployment switch

admit.operation: compare one executable rule with one q_C
